reasoning: Re-verified against main c8c2e8c after #218, #220 and #223: the `planning` and `implementation` MODIFIED requirements are today's spec text minus their Codex phrase only (diffed requirement by requirement), the `distribution` delta drops the link requirement and the two Codex phrases the current text still carries, task 4.2's grep run on this tree reports exactly 23 files and every one is edited or removed by a task, the telemetry exclusion path is the moved `.agent-process/docs/telemetry-measurement-setup.md` (15 Codex mentions, so the exclusion is load-bearing), the merged consumer caller `skills/agent-process/templates/agent-review.yml` passes no input and pins `@v${version}` as the Non-goal and D1 state, and 0033 is the next free ADR number after #223's 0032 — so the plan is still a subtractive minimum for the 2026-09-27 decision with every catcher reaching a delivery step.

simpler.evidence: The change stays subtractive: design.md Goals states the invariant (no step, script, file, spec or procedure line names Codex as live) and D1-D8 remove rather than add — one workflow input, one script branch set, four modules, seven `.agents/` paths of `OPENSPEC_OUTPUT` (`init.py:65-77`), one installer step and its three conflict cases leave; the only new files are the ADR and a `git mv`. The two simplifications that would go further are weighed on checked mechanisms: D1's alternative (drop the first presence read and always review) is rejected because `resolve_review_thread`'s `gh run rerun` re-executes every step (issue 139), so an unchanged head would be reviewed again and could gain threads; D5's alternative (drop the user-scope checkout and hand off from a temporary clone) is deferred because it changes the confirm path (`init.py:897` builds the step list with `_checkout` and `_link`, `_perform` hands off at `init.py:922-923`) and its retry tests — a different unit (§VII, one-PR-one-unit). D7a is the smallest correction for the contradiction it found: one paragraph, in the file that holds it, instead of a second change and a second PR. The rename is not churn — after this change the script requests nothing — and `git mv` keeps history. D3 leaves the two `_REVIEWERS` constants separate (`.agent-process/scripts/check_blocking_review_threads.py:25`, `skills/agent-process/scripts/resolve_review_thread.py:30`), correctly: two separately shipped trees, no abstraction earned. One residue is below a finding but named for the planner: after task 1.1 drops the three `link-*` conflict cases, `tests/publisher/test_init_conflicts.py:73-78` (`_link_real_directory`, `_link_elsewhere`) and `tests/publisher/init_harness.py:269-277` (`link_command`, with its Runner branch at 241-244 and its `state_changing` key at 256-257) have no caller left, since no installer step issues a link command any more; `Sandbox.link` stays live through the new `test_user_skill_path_is_left_alone`. Sweeping those ~12 test-harness lines in the same task avoids a later leftovers PR (#218's class).

Hook denial -> the `.claude/settings.json` deny-list -> `test_claude_denies_push_to_main_force_push_and_merge` (three of its 14 rules; the other eleven stay untested, the level before this change, and the removed hook test also proved configuration only). Silent Claude action -> `Verify the Claude review of the head` at 60 s -> the step reds the required `agent-review` context. Reader crash -> the `case` default -> the step fails before the action runs. Leftover Codex text outside `openspec`, `tests`, the ADRs and the telemetry doc -> task 4.2's grep, re-run on c8c2e8c: it reports exactly 23 files and every one is edited or removed by a task (`REVIEW_CONTRACT.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `SKILL.md` 4.1; `check_blocking_review_threads.py`, `resolve_review_thread.py`, `wait_for_pr.py` 2.3; `codex_hooks.py`, `check_codex_project_trust.py`, `.codex/hooks.json`, the seven `.agents/skills/` files, `hooks.py`, `navigation_policy.py` 3.1; `request_codex_review.py` 1.1/2.1; both workflows 2.2; `init.py` 3.3 — whose five Codex mentions, lines 10, 63, 446, 468 and 487, the task covers one by one; `start_change.py` 3.2, whose mentions are the usage lines 4-5 and `CARRIERS` at 45), and the pathspec `':!.agent-process/docs/telemetry-measurement-setup.md'` is #218's moved path, carrying 15 Codex mentions, so the exclusion is load-bearing rather than stale. 2.3 names `resolve_review_thread.py`'s comment and operator message at lines 242 and 268, still those lines today, so that code edit lands in the Group 2 commit, not the docs one; no test pins that message text. The deliberate exception -> the direct edit of `openspec/specs/roles/spec.md` -> task 6.2's report, which explains the one-paragraph Purpose edit with D7a's archive observation. This change's own PR is still reviewed: the caller drops `with` while the callee reached at `@main` keeps `codex-timeout-seconds` with `default: 600`, so its head pays one 600 s read, exits 3, and the Claude review plus the P0/P1 gate run — no green head without a review; after the merge caller and callee move together (`@main`, ADR 0012), the Migration Plan's rollback.
